text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, who will make the move?!
Who will be the one to bring this heated battle to an end?!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. It's giving me chills...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, your true best makes
my heart flutter this much!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: No, that's not it. This is—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Is this... your way of running?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOAAAAAAHH...!!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hah... Hah...
*pant*...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: My, aren't you strong, Chiyo-chan.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Aah, I gave it my all and still lost!
I'm so, SO frustrated!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...It was fun, though.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"While I was running, my heart was pounding,
I was so thrilled... and I just didn't want to lose."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I want to run on and on forever,
and beat you...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I wonder why.
The only thing spilling over should be smiles.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure it's because
it was a match where we clashed with everything we had."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"It is precisely because you gave it your all that losing hurts so deeply.
That is what racing against a rival is all about."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...I had already realized those feelings
back around the Satsuki Sho, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh... fufu, Chiyo-chan, honestly...
Look who's learned to talk back.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...I'll never forget this.
I'll remember today forever. I was so happy.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes, me too... But.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: It doesn't matter if you forget.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Because I don't want you to just settle for memories.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen-san, we are rivals.
Let's keep running in lots of races together!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Even if the memories of each individual race
fade away, we just have to experience
new happiness together again!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Chiyo-chan.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Understood, Rival.
I look forward to continuing to work with you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes!! I won't lose either!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
I have returned.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes. Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
did you see the moment
I beat Maruzen-san?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ooh... Heh heh...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Then, as a reward.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Please praise me with a 'Good job!'.
Head pats are also permitted."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Eek!
Fufu... fuhehe...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe...! Pet me more, pet me more!
I just did something super amazing, you know!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her hair all messy and ruffled,
Sakura Chiyono O smiled with complete satisfaction.
